question: International Kite Festival is a popular cultural festival of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujrat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of the most famous kite festivals is the International Kite Festival held in Ahmedabad, India, every January.
 
• Kite flying is believed to have originated in China over 2,000 years ago. 
 
• The festival is organized to celebrate Makar Sankranti, a harvest festival in India.
 
• The record for the largest kite is held by a kite created in Mexico, measuring over 1,200 square meters.
